name: Ark: Dragontopia
summary:
Tame the legends. Rule the skies.

Awaken in a cloudbound paradise where the earth has fractured into a world of floating islands and myths take flight. High above these magical battlegrounds, Survivors must learn a new rhythm of survival alongside the true rulers of the sky: the dragons. Guided by the echoes of a lost order of dragonriders, enter a land where legends breathe anew. As a fierce new threat claims the horizon, it is up to you to restore balance!

Between the sun and moon, the skies teem with draconic legends waiting to be discovered. Encounter titanic behemoths that devour resources and enemies alike, and elegant, wind-dancing steeds that gallop across the clouds. From deadly four-winged assassins, to multi-headed beasts of dual-breathed chaos, and loyal shoulder-drakes that guard you on your journey, every dragon in this realm demands its own path to taming. But the skies are actively contested, and you are the realm's last hope to break the vanguard of a ruthless airborne invader!
